sentences.text:
And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard the learned counsel for the applicant as well as the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.126 of 2017, under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 313 I.P.C., 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 registered at Police Station Kunda, District Pratapgarh.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 21.04.2017, against four persons, including the applicant, alleging that informant got married to the applicant's son,
co-accused- Vishal Kumar Gupta on 22.02.2016; that all the accused persons used to harass her for dowry demand and they forcibly turned her out from her matrimonial home on 27.05.2016.
4.

In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the applicant is a 79 years old person having no criminal history and he has falsely been implicated in the present case because of matrimonial dispute between the informant and her husband.

sentences.text: The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that a co-accused Shalini Gupta @ Neha has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 19.09.2023 passed by this court in Criminal Misc. Anticipatory bail Application No. 2030 of 2023.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Anticipatory bail Application No. 2030 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is a 79 years old person having no criminal history; that a co-accused has already been granted bail and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is also entitled to be grated anticipatory bail.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
